_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Technical Assist Visit Report
summary: The Technical Assist Visit Report provides the Government with engineering analysis findings and immediate reporting of failures, subsequent details, and corrective action recommendations from technical representatives.
use_relationship:
The Technical Assist Visit Report will provide the Government with engineering analysis findings identified by the technical representatives. It will provide immediate reporting of failure and subsequent details and corrective action recommendations.
This data item description (DID) contains format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall be the contractor's format

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall contain the following sections:

children.title: Identity of the SWRMC Technician performing the analysis
children.content: name, grade, rank and email address

children.title: Identity of the SHIPS Technician performing the analysis
children.content: name, grade, rank, and email address.

children.title: Identity of the person that will be providing the out brief
children.content: name, grade, rank and email address.

children.title: Report deficiencies.
children.content: Identify all deficiencies found on the applicable equipment analyzed

children.title: The report shall include all findings
children.content: and include detailed recommendations for corrections to the problem(s) found.

children.title: The report shall identify all planned maintenance system (PMS) checks made.
All applicable technical reference documents needed for use of each repair shall be specified.
List the total amount of training that shall be required
children.content: include skill levels, and appropriate FTEs needed.
